tasks.gr11-recruitment-selection-contracts-t4: Topic: Recruitment, Selection and Contracts. Cover internal vs external recruitment, the selection process (shortlisting, interviews, testing), types of employment contracts (fixed-term, permanent, part-time), and legal requirements under the Labour Relations Act. Ask learners to sequence HR steps, compare contract types, or recommend a recruitment approach.
tasks.gr11-induction-salary-benefits-t4: Topic: Induction, Salary and Benefits. Cover the induction process, salary determination (job grading, market surveys, BCEA minimums), benefits packages, and the purpose of remuneration in retaining talent. Ask learners to explain induction steps, compare salary determination methods, or identify appropriate benefits for a given role.
tasks.gr11-revision-environments-ventures-t4: Topic: Revision — Environments and Ventures. Cover all Grade 11 business environments content (micro, market, macro), socio-economic challenges, forms of ownership, acquisition methods, entrepreneurial qualities, and business planning. Ask structured revision questions mixing define-explain-apply formats, scenario analysis, and comparison tables.
tasks.gr11-revision-operations-exam-prep-t4: Topic: Revision — Operations and Exam Prep. Cover Grade 11 operations, marketing, quality, ethics, teamwork, HR, and creative thinking content in integrated case-study and essay formats. Ask learners to tackle cross-topic scenarios, practice long responses, compare business functions, and use correct business terminology.
